# evroc_project (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing evroc project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the project was created (RFC3339 format).
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly display name of the project.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization` (String) Organization ID this project belongs to.
- `project_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the project.
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels attached to the project.
